configuration.title: ExDiff
setting.baseRef.description: Base branch or revision. `auto` reads the current branch's creation reflog (`branch: Created from …`) to find its parent branch/commit, then uses the nearest merge-base among local and remote branches, then `HEAD~1`. **ExDiff: Open Changes with Base** compares from the merge-base (fork point) with `HEAD`. Set an explicit branch such as `origin/main` to override.
setting.snapshotDir.description: Directory that holds the materialized snapshots. Supported variables: `${repoRoot}` (repository root), `${repoParent}` (parent directory of the repository), `${repoName}` (repository folder name) and `${slot}` (snapshot slot). Defaults to `${repoRoot}/.exdiff`, which lives inside the repository and is git-ignored so `git status` stays clean. Relative templates resolve against the repository root.
setting.snapshotRetentionDays.descriptio: Number of days a snapshot is kept before it is pruned automatically. At startup only the ad-hoc `ref-*` slots are pruned; **ExDiff: Prune Stale Snapshots** prunes every expired slot. Set to `0` to turn automatic pruning off.
setting.autoAttach.description: Whether the snapshot folders are added to the workspace as extra workspace folders. This is what makes language features (hover, Go to Definition, Find References, diagnostics) work on the base side of the diff.
setting.autoAttach.ask.description: Ask once and remember the answer.
setting.autoAttach.always.description: Always add the snapshot folders to the workspace.
setting.autoAttach.never.description: Never add the snapshot folders to the workspace.
setting.rightSide.description: What the right-hand side of the diff shows.
setting.rightSide.workingTree.descriptio: Compare the snapshot against the file as it is on disk, including uncommitted changes.
setting.rightSide.ref.description: Compare the snapshot against the other revision (no working tree involved).
setting.gitPath.description: Path to the `git` executable. Useful when Git is not on `PATH`.
setting.maxFilesInTree.description: Maximum number of changed files listed in the **Changes** view. Larger change sets are truncated with a hint.
